items.program_name: 雇用創出税額控除(OH JCTC)
items.summary: オハイオ州租税信用機構(Ohio Tax Credit Authority)がIMCO Carbide Tool社(Perrysburg Township, Wood County)に9年間1.341%の雇用創出税額控除(JCTC)を承認、92人の新規雇用と年間$4,693,831の新規給与創出を約束。
items.infer: 受領者名(Carbide Tool)から超硬工具・切削工具メーカーと見られ、新規雇用92人を伴う事業拡大は生産設備・加工機の増設投資を伴う可能性(推論)。
items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a Job Creation Tax Credit of 1.341% for 9 years on 2022-08-29 for a project in Perrysburg Township, Wood County. Commitment: create 92 full-time equivalent employees generating $4,693,831 in new annual payroll at the project location.
